name: data-database-dmloptions-state-runtime-depth
salesforceExclusionReason: Local DMLOptions state and modeled partial-success DML only.

source.content: Database.DMLOptions opts = new Database.DMLOptions(); opts.allowFieldTruncation = true; opts.optAllOrNone = false; System.DMLOptions systemOpts = new System.DMLOptions(); systemOpts.allowFieldTruncation = true; systemOpts.optAllOrNone = false; System.assertEquals(true, systemOpts.AllowFieldTruncation); System.assertEquals(false, systemOpts.OptAllOrNone); System.assertEquals(true, opts.AllowFieldTruncation); System.assertEquals(false, opts.OptAllOrNone); Database.DMLOptions copied = (Database.DMLOptions)opts.clone(); System.assertEquals(true, copied.AllowFieldTruncation); System.assertEquals(false, copied.OptAllOrNone); SObject account = new Account(Name = 'Optioned'); account.setOptions(opts); System.assertEquals(true, account.getOptions().AllowFieldTruncation); System.assertEquals(false, account.getOptions().OptAllOrNone); Account good = new Account(Name = 'Good'); Account bad = new Account(); List<Database.SaveResult> results = Database.insert(new List<Account>{good, bad}, opts); System.assertEquals(2, results.size()); System.assert(results[0].isSuccess()); System.assert(!results[1].isSuccess());
